verdict.rationale: Cognee ships a well-documented Python SDK with core operations (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget), plus a CLI and MCP server that mirror the same API, all confirmed by first-party docs and runtime probes showing the CLI and MCP server actually work locally. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other languages (e.g., JS/TS) and independent third-party developer testimonials beyond the runtime probes.
